transcript.text: Back in 2025 I spent a few days in Guangzhou for work, and I remember chatting with coworkers about what hotels were like around there.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That same spring I also had a quick stop in Shanghai, and we ended up talking about attractions in the city like it was a whole checklist.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the Guangzhou part, my coworker Emily Wang had the stay under her name at the Four Seasons Guangzhou.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I’m pretty sure her check-in date was 2025-04-12, and they stayed 3 nights—she kept joking about how fast it flew by.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And in Shanghai, my friend Ethan Thomas told me he’d already gotten a single ticket (just 1) for Shanghai Disneyland on 2025-03-19, for the afternoon slot.
